name: kg_find_edge
description:
This tool finds edges connected to a specific node, with optional filtering by text search and other criteria. It returns the most relevant edges based on importance, recency, and text matching.
Available filters: start_date, end_date, node_types (Entity, Event, State, Goal, Property, Concept), node_ids, exclude_nodes, max_hops, text (filters connected nodes by their labels).

inputs.name: node_id
inputs.description: The UUID of the node to find edges for.

inputs.name: k
inputs.description: Maximum number of edges to return (default: 5)

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Optional text to filter edges by (searches in connected node labels)

inputs.name: filters
inputs.description: Optional additional filters to restrict search scope

arguments_prompt: The node_id to find edges for, plus optional filters like relationship type, text search, direction, and date range.
